In the "Data Analysis" section, the "Instrument" used consists of the three mentioned stages
(emotion coding, identification and/or interpretation of causes of reported emotions, and
identification of themes based on emotional geography structure), based on Hargreaves (1998a).
However, it is unclear how these three stages were adapted to the Indonesian context and what
procedures were taken to validate these stages. The entire validation process and reliability of
these three stages must be clarified to validate the study results effectively.

Thank you very much for your suggestions. I will definitely make an improvement based on
what you suggested.
